title: After US-003 inverted the seam (the four builders now delegate to ClaudeAdapter…
description:
After US-003 inverted the seam (the four builders now delegate to ClaudeAdapter.buildSpawnArgv), the golden comparisons adapter.buildSpawnArgv(actor, opts) vs buildXWorkerArgv(opts) are self-referential: the builder is a thin wrapper over the same adapter call, so byte-for-byte equality is trivially true. Genuine behavior lock still lives in the unchanged sibling tests (worker-argv.test.ts / plan-argv.test.ts / review.test.ts) which assert literal argv substrings (env -u CLAUDECODE, CAM_WORKER=1, --agent, --permission-mode), so coverage is not lost. Consider pinning a hardcoded golden string in backend-adapter.test.ts to keep it a real characterization independent of the wrappers. Non-blocking; carried over from review round 1.

Source: cam/issue-339
Review round: 2
